# 0103-xds-sds-server-cert

Cross-side EXACT differential for the phase 60.2 SDS server-cert apply lift
(ADR-0280). Proves that envoy-go (subject, in-process) and reference Envoy
(`contrib-v1.37.2`, Docker) both serve the **SAME downstream TLS leaf
certificate fetched via a State-of-the-World Secret Discovery Service (SDS)
gRPC stream** — not an inlined `tls_certificates` bootstrap value.

## Topology

Single-listener downstream-TLS `tcp_proxy` (`l_sds_tls`), whose
`DownstreamTlsContext` carries:

```yaml
common_tls_context:
  tls_certificate_sds_secret_configs:
    - name: server_cert
      sds_config:
        resource_api_version: V3
        api_config_source:
          api_type: GRPC
          transport_api_version: V3
          grpc_services:
            - envoy_grpc: { cluster_name: sds_cluster }
```

`sds_cluster` is an **h2c** cluster (`http2_protocol_options: {}`, no TLS)
pointing at a driver-owned in-process `test/helpers/sdsserver` receiver. No
`tls_inspector` listener filter is needed — a single filter chain, no SNI
match (the `0018-http-rbac` precedent).

`node: { id: envoygo-node, cluster: envoygo-cluster }` is **required** on
both sides — SDS boot-fails without it
(`internal/boot.NewSDSProvider`, arm 7).

## Two private per-side SDS receivers + hard `Close()`

Mirrors the `0089-stats-sink-metrics-service` precedent
(`reference_periodic_sink_differential_two_receivers`,
`reference_differential_grpc_receiver_driver_owned`): the driver starts
**two private `sdsserver.Server` receivers** — one per side — on two
separately-allocated host ports, each bound `0.0.0.0:<port>` BEFORE either
proxy starts, BOTH configured to deliver the **same committed leaf**
(`pki/leaf.pem` + `pki/leaf.key.pem`) under secret name `server_cert`. The
reference container reaches its receiver at `host.docker.internal:<refPort>`
(ADR-0010 STRICT_DNS bridge alias); the subject reaches its receiver at
`127.0.0.1:<subjPort>` (STATIC). After the subject drive completes, both
receivers are hard-stopped via `Close()` (`grpc.Server.Stop`), NOT
`Stop()`/`GracefulStop` — like `StreamMetrics`, SDS's `StreamSecrets` is
long-lived (the proxy holds the stream open awaiting future secret
rotations), so `GracefulStop` would block until the test timeout.

## Workload

Each side dials the proxy's `l_sds_tls` listener and completes a TLS
1.2+/1.3 handshake (`helpers.TLSServedLeaf`), validating against the
committed `pki/ca.pem` with `ServerName: sds.envoy-go.test`. **No
application data is written** — the observable is the served certificate's
identity, not echoed bytes. The `c_backend` TCP echo backend
(`BackendCount() == 1`) exists only so `tcp_proxy` has somewhere to route;
it is never exercised.

## Asserted (cross-side EXACT via `CompareBytes`)

The served leaf's:

```
serial=53445330313033
san=sds.envoy-go.test
```

proving both proxies served the *same* SDS-delivered leaf.

## PKI

`pki/ca.pem` / `pki/leaf.pem` / `pki/leaf.key.pem` — a self-signed test CA +
one server leaf (`CN=sds.envoy-go.test`, `SAN=DNS:sds.envoy-go.test`, fixed
distinctive serial `0x53445330313033` — the ASCII hex spelling of
`"SDS0103"`). Generated by a one-shot generator that is **not** committed;
the committed PEMs are the authoritative source. To rotate, regenerate with
a fresh one-shot `crypto/x509` program and re-commit the three files.

## UNasserted

The `tcp_proxy` echo path (never exercised). SDS stream framing
(`VersionInfo`/`Nonce`/request-count/ACK cadence — impl-specific; only the
*delivered secret identity* is asserted). The `sds.<secret>.*` stat counters
(surfaced by phase 60.1's `xds.RegisterSDSStats`; no `StatsAsserter` here).

## Liveness proof

Step 6 of the phase-60.2 Task 7 brief temporarily pointed the
reference-side `sdsserver.Server` at a **different** leaf (distinct serial,
same SAN, signed by a throwaway second CA the driver's `caPool` was also
temporarily made to trust) — the TLS handshake still completed on both
sides, but `CompareBytes` failed on the `serial=` line, confirming the
assertion fires on the served-leaf observable and not a boot/handshake
error. See `docs/envoy-go/phases/60-xds-sds-server-cert/PROGRESS-60.2.md`
for the captured break evidence.
